name: quiz_created
definition: The event is emitted anytime a new classic quiz is created by an end user or API request.
trigger: Triggered when a new classic quiz [old quizzes] is created in a course.

schema.quiz_id: The Canvas id of the quiz.
schema.assignment_id: The Canvas id of the associated assignment, if the quiz is graded.
schema.context_id: The Canvas id for the context the quiz is used in.
schema.context_type: The type of context the quiz is used in (usually Course).
schema.context_uuid: The uuid of the context associated with the quiz.
schema.title: The title of the quiz. NOTE: This field will be truncated to only include the first 8192 characters.
schema.description: The description of the quiz. NOTE: This field will be truncated to only include the first 8192 characters.
schema.quiz_type: The type of quiz (assignment, practice_quiz, graded_survey, survey).
schema.points_possible: The maximum points possible for the quiz.
schema.due_at: The due date for the quiz.
schema.lock_at: The lock date (quiz is locked after this date).
schema.unlock_at: The unlock date (quiz is unlocked after this date).
schema.time_limit: The time limit for taking the quiz, in minutes.
schema.access_code: Whether the quiz requires an access code (boolean, does not expose the actual code).
schema.ip_filter: The IP address filter for taking the quiz.
schema.shuffle_answers: Whether answer choices are shuffled for each student.
schema.scoring_policy: The scoring policy for multiple attempts (keep_highest, keep_latest).
schema.hide_results: When to hide results from students (null, always, until_after_last_attempt).
schema.show_correct_answers: Whether correct answers are shown to students after submission.
schema.show_correct_answers_at: The date after which correct answers are shown.
schema.hide_correct_answers_at: The date after which correct answers are hidden.
schema.show_correct_answers_last_attempt: Whether correct answers are only shown after the last attempt.
schema.one_question_at_a_time: Whether the quiz shows one question at a time.
schema.cant_go_back: Whether students cannot return to previous questions (only applies when one_question_at_a_time is true).
schema.one_time_results: Whether students can only view results once.
schema.require_lockdown_browser: Whether the quiz requires a lockdown browser.
schema.require_lockdown_browser_for_results: Whether viewing results requires a lockdown browser.
schema.only_visible_to_overrides: Whether the quiz is only visible to students with overrides.
schema.workflow_state: Workflow state of the quiz (created, edited, available, unpublished, deleted).
schema.updated_at: The time at which this quiz was last modified in any way.
